description: Free, rate-limited. Coarse status and quality score for one x402 endpoint URL, from the index only (no fresh probe). Use when: you only need a quick yes/no on whether Settled knows the URL and its last status. Not for: deciding whether to pay — use settled_check (free, fuller) or settled_preflight (paid, fresh). If the URL is unknown, call settled_submit, then check again later.

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://api.example.com/search

name: settled_peek

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

detail.description: Where to get the full check

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

seller_claimed.description: Whether the seller has claimed it

status.description: Endpoint status, e.g. live, degraded, dead, free, auth_gated, not_found or quote_invalid

title: Peek at an endpoint
